verdict.rationale: Auth0's own marketing and pricing pages say enterprise clients can synchronize user directories via SCIM, and the pricing page lists SCIM as a new feature. That establishes SCIM inbound provisioning as a first-party capability. The evidence covers only directory sync in general, not group sync or deprovisioning that revokes app access. Missing for 10: documented group sync via SCIM, documented deprovisioning behavior that revokes sessions or app access, in-depth SCIM docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can sync users and groups from customer directories via SCIM so deprovisioning in the IdP revokes app access

citations.quote: Give your enterprise clients the autonomous tools to instantly configure SSO, verify domain ownership, and synchronize user directories via SCIM or Google Workspace.
